with_issues.note: ppt-web (cloud-landable). PR #3004 (gh-issue-3000) added authenticatedFetch raw-Response primitive in @ppt/api-client lib/fetch.ts and routed gdprFetch + paymentMatching.uploadStatement through it; PR itself well-shaped (multipart boundary preserved, base-URL unified on client.getConfig(), strong IG3 tests). MEDIUM better-approach finding #3006: lib/fetch.ts now holds TWO near-duplicate retry-aware auth primitives (fetchJsonInner + new authenticatedFetchInner) plus a third header-injection copy in generated auth/interceptors.ts, and they ALREADY diverge — getAuthHeaders()/authenticatedFetchJson sets only Authorization; authenticatedFetchInner sets Authorization + X-Tenant-ID. Proposal: extract applyAuthHeaders() + shouldRetryOnMfa401() consumed by both, forcing one explicit decision on the header set (JSON path's missing X-Tenant-ID looks unintentional) aligned with the interceptor.

with_issues.note: gh-issue-2947 fix purges @ppt/access_log, @ppt/qr_scan_history, @ppt/feedback_drafts, @ppt/pending_feedback, @ppt/faq_votes via new TENANT_SCOPED_EXACT_KEYS registry in resetLocalData() -- correct and well-tested for what it covers. 1 finding, security(high): auditing the same NFCCredentialManager.ts this PR references turned up two still-uncovered, MORE sensitive keys neither resetLocalData() nor AuthContext.login()/logout() touch: (1) LEGACY_CREDENTIALS_KEY='@ppt/nfc_credentials' (raw unencrypted legacy credential blob in AsyncStorage, not in TENANT_SCOPED_EXACT_KEYS) -- if migration hasn't run yet this session, the prior tenant's blob survives resetLocalData() and the next tenant's loadStoredCredentials() silently adopts it as its own; (2) CREDENTIALS_KEY='ppt_nfc_credentials'+chunk slots in expo-secure-store (written by storeCredentials()) are never cleared on session change at all -- resetLocalData() only touches AsyncStorage. Between logout and the next tenant's first fetchCredentials(), the prior tenant's actual NFC building-access credential material (not just the log) remains loadable -- same shared-device leak class this PR fixed for the log, but for the credential itself. Proposed: expose NFCCredentialManager.clearAllLocalCredentials() (wrapping the existing private clearStoredCredentials() + AsyncStorage.removeItem(LEGACY_CREDENTIALS_KEY)) and call it from resetLocalData() or alongside it in AuthContext login/logout; add a regression test mirroring resetLocalData.test.ts's new it.each block. Filed #2953.

gh-issue-2948 generalizes queryKeys.test.ts to auto-discover feature-local *Keys factories via import.meta.glob('../features/**/hooks/*.{ts,tsx}',{eager:true}) instead of a hand-maintained import list -- correct fix for the 'reviewer must remember' gap, incidentally also now covers messagingKeys which the old hardcoded list missed. 2 low findings: (1) test-gaps -- rootOf(name,factory)'s shape assertions run inside the it.each-table-building .map(), i.e. at describe-evaluation time not inside an it() callback, so a malformed factory would throw during suite collection and abort the WHOLE file's tests instead of failing just its own named row; proposed moving the assertion inside the it.each callback. (2) correctness -- the glob '../features/**/hooks/*.{ts,tsx}' only matches files directly under a hooks/ dir (trailing single '*', not '**'), so a factory in a nested features/<x>/hooks/queries/<y>.ts would silently escape discovery again -- no such nested layout exists today (latent, not live) but is exactly the failure mode this PR closes; proposed widening to 'hooks/**/*.{ts,tsx}'. Filed #2954.
